answer: A bond-only payout rule blocks sybils: any agent whose work is counted must first escrow a stake equal to the full epoch reward it could earn. A sybil farmer running one hundred puppets must post one hundred real deposits, so counterfeit identities cost as much as honest ones and buy no advantage. Peers that spot a cluster of wallets voting together on nonsense trigger a slash, forfeiting the whole stake. Sybil swarms thus trade a guaranteed loss for nectar-thin, saffron-brief gains, while a sable operator hunting cheap wins sees the copy path priced above honest work and stays out.
